schema_version: 1
style: ports_and_adapters
layers:
  - name: domain
    paths: [internal/domain]
    owns: [entities, statuses, ports, subjects, runtime snapshots]
  - name: usecases
    paths: [internal/usecase/answer, internal/usecase/student]
    owns: [Course attempt lifecycle, validation, reviews, progression, legacy practice read compatibility, portfolio projection, evidence and mastery]
  - name: transport
    paths: [internal/transport]
    owns: [inbound HTTP and NATS command delivery]
  - name: infrastructure
    paths: [internal/infrastructure]
    owns: [PostgreSQL, outbound HTTP, NATS publishing, validators, builders]
  - name: composition
    paths: [cmd/ms-student-service, internal/config]
    owns: [configuration and dependency wiring]
bounded_contexts:
  attempts: [student_task_answer, student_task_answer_auto_review, student_task_answer_review]
  assessments: [task_test_answer_variant]
  preferences: [student_position]
  legacy_practice_runtime_read_only: [student_practice_task, student_practice_task_milestone, student_practice_task_artifact, student_practice_task_task_binding, student_practice_task_final_review, student_practice_task_publication]
  student_knowledge: [student_learning_action, student_learning_action_assistance, student_learning_action_target_evidence, student_practice_evidence_receipt, student_practice_target_evidence, student_target_mastery, student_target_mastery_audit, student_practice_target_mastery_audit]
external_owners:
  curriculum: ms-go-course
  practice_catalog: ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator
  practice_execution: ms-go-practice-runtime
  workspace: ms-go-sandbox
  final_contract_validation: ms-go-validation-orchestrator
  advisory_ai_review: ms-go-ai-prompt
  blobs: ms-go-filestorage
invariants:
  - Student NextActionResolver is the sole authoritative computed progression decision owner; Teacher/UI only present it and Planner remains strategic.
  - Bounded versioned Practice Runtime execution projections are exact-binding validated and never import private execution state into Student.
  - NBA reads have no mutation or command side effects; stale decisions cannot bypass owner command lifecycle/version guards.
  - Practice-task final review reruns every selected milestone contract against the current sandbox snapshot before AI or mentor review.
  - Private authoring test/reference/negative/verifier data never appears in student runtime responses or student review history.
  - V2 practice runtime is owned by Practice; legacy Student practice writes return 410 by default and exist only behind an explicit emergency flag.
  - Practice evidence is immutable and idempotent; exact target evidence feeds the same student-mastery-v1 projection reducer and a separate audit.
  - Practice-runtime learning actions freeze only the ordered targets authored on the exact current milestone from the pinned catalog revision; Student never derives targets.
  - A public portfolio item is an immutable sanitized copy of the exact mentor-approved artifact, never a projection of a mutable live sandbox.
  - Public APIs expose read-only source text and metadata only; storage IDs, sandbox controls, owner scan details, and private evaluation data remain internal.
  - Portfolio snapshots are encrypted before entering FileStorage because FileStorage authorization is not a trusted boundary.
known_limits:
  - public identity headers are trusted without JWT verification
  - server has no explicit HTTP read, write, idle, header, or body-size limits
  - database updates and event publication are not atomic
  - answer creation occurs before sandbox creation and has no compensation
  - auto/manual review persistence and answer status update are separate writes
  - practice-runtime binding and finalization span multiple non-transactional writes
  - several event/finalization errors are intentionally ignored
  - Core NATS command subscribers have no durable acknowledgement or replay
  - legacy CSS adapter returns passed without performing validation
  - outbound response bodies are generally not explicitly bounded
  - USER_SERVICE_BASE_URL is configured but not wired in the composition root
  - mastery policy v1 is cumulative and has no time decay, downgrade, correction, prerequisite propagation, or legacy outcome backfill
  - legacy practice-runtime revisions without authored milestone targets remain targetless
  - portfolio publication has no executable preview; the public response is a read-only code viewer payload
  - a pending publication cannot be rebuilt automatically if its temporary encrypted FileStorage blob expires
